metadata.title: HKT geometry on locally conformally hyperkähler manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study the HKT geometry of compact locally conformally hyperkähler manifolds. We prove that on these manifolds the quaternionic Monge-Ampère equation is always solvable, extending results of Alesker and of Dinew-Sroka, and we confirm the conjecture on the maximal existence time of the HKT-Ricci flow. On quaternionic Hopf surfaces we construct non-trivial HKT solitons and prove convergence of the normalized flow for symmetric initial data.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: locally conformally hyperkähler 上的 HKT 方程与流
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 locally conformally hyperkähler 流形证明 quaternionic Monge–Ampère 可解并确认 HKT-Ricci 流最大存在时间猜想；Hopf 曲面构造非平凡 HKT soliton 并证明对称初值归一化流收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一静态可解性、存在时间与对称流极限。
analysis.limitations: 收敛限于 quaternionic Hopf 曲面的对称初值，不能推广到全部 HKT 流。
